name: positioning-copilot
description:
Positioning Copilot helps creative studio founders carve out a position that makes their studio the obvious choice for the right buyers. It diagnoses why buyers aren't seeing the studio clearly and coaches founders through sharper positioning grounded in their actual work.

Signed-in Forum members get full coaching that uses their studio's Centerfile. Without signing in, it runs in a limited diagnostic mode.

A Forum AI Copilot by Joel Pilger.
